additions.reason: The 'מוח' (brain/intellect) is what the great leader draws down even to the רגלין. The Rebbe says: 'עַל־יְדֵי גְּדֻלַּת הַמַּנְהִיג יָכוֹל לְהַמְשִׁיךְ הַמֹּחַ אֲפִלּוּ לְהָרַגְלִין'. While there is a directional (eitza) relationship between מנהיג and מוח (the leader draws down intellect), the מוח itself is a bechina of the domain of the leader — da'at, intellect, the higher faculty that the leader embodies and transmits. It belongs in Package 3 as the defining content/quality of the leader's essence.

analysis_notes.no_evil_mirror: This Torah has no evil polarity packages. The teaching is entirely about the positive dimension: the greatness of creation's purpose (tachlit), the lower ones (raglin) who can still attain it, and the great leader who makes it possible. There is no evil counterpart discussed in this Torah — the challenge (suffering in this world, 'noach lo la'adam she'lo nivra') is not assigned evil polarity but is a philosophical observation resolved by the tachlit argument.
